title: Data Table
description: The table with its working clothes on: sortable columns, selectable rows, and an honest footer.
usage: For admin lists where the reader compares, sorts and acts. Read-only data stays a plain Table; the moment headers sort and rows select, it is this part.
a11y: Sort state lives on aria-sort at the column header; checkboxes carry row names in their labels. Sorting is stable and never reorders under a screen reader without announcing it.
